note: 트레이너 카드 능력의 짧은 영어 문구(M9 언어 ① — trainer-short-ko.json의 영어 짝, 결정 87 V11 라): 해금 카드(CardFx)의 능력 칸에 싣는 48자 이하 요약 — 키 = <카드 키>.<1|2>(1 = 파랑, 2 = 빨강) → strings.en의 trainer_ability.<키>.short. 전체 영문(xlsx trainer_cards, trainer_ability.<키>.text)이 48자 이하면 적지 않는다(빌드가 전체 영문을 그대로 쓴다). 48자를 넘는 전체 영문에 짧은 문구가 없거나 짧은 문구가 48자를 넘으면 빌드가 실패한다. 낱말은 원작 영문(Initiative · Journey Points · Apricorn · tile)을 쓰고 위력은 화면 말 power다 [가정 §5 #361].

short.ace_trainer.1: Retry 1 search per encounter; cheap Battle Items
short.aroma_lady.1: Apricorn Tree captures: 1 status → regular hit
short.aroma_lady.2: Grass/Fairy attacks heal half the damage dealt.
short.artist.1: Teach a defeated wild Pokémon's move to anyone.
short.artist.2: Every move type in party: all moves +2 power.
short.backpacker.1: After any battle, fully heal 1 party Pokémon.
short.backpacker.2: Pokémon can hold 2 different Held Items.
short.bird_keeper.1: Fly to a village from anywhere for 1 Apricorn.
short.bird_keeper.2: Flying types ignore attacks of 2 damage or less
short.black_belt.1: Defeat a wild Pokémon: +2 Journey Points.
short.black_belt.2: Burn your Pokémon; burned Fighting types +2.
short.bug_catcher.1: Catch a Bug type: +2 JP and an extra turn.
short.bug_catcher.2: Bug types: +2 Initiative, Bug moves +1 power.
short.chef.1: Swap bag Apricorns for others of the same tier.
short.chef.2: 1 of each Apricorn: same-type moves +1 power.
short.collector.2: Take stamp reward moves as Pokémon instead.
short.delinquent.1: Gain the Apricorns others offer at Shrines.
short.delinquent.2: Dark and Poison types take 2 less damage.
short.diamond_acolyte.1: Follow Dialga; your token counts as 2 cards.
short.diamond_acolyte.2: Get Dialga; weaker for each missing Shard.
short.dragon_tamer.1: Get a Weak Dragon type holding Apex Dragon.
short.essentia.1: After a battle, use your leftover movement.
short.essentia.2: Not moved yet: first wild attack deals double.
short.expert.1: Shrine Offerings draw 1 extra card to choose.
short.expert.2: Beast Boost: Legendaries heal 3, reset fatigue.
short.fairy_tale_girl.1: Your Pokémon heal 1 extra whenever healed.
short.fairy_tale_girl.2: Make your Pokémon drowsy; drowsy Fairies heal.
short.fisherman.1: Reef captures: 1 status → hit; roll Catch Size.
short.fisherman.2: Health + Catch Size; 2 JP raises Catch Size.
short.gardener.1: Once per turn, take 1 Apricorn from your tree.
short.gardener.2: Grass and Rock types: +3 Initiative, −2 Health.
short.gentleman.1: Double Apricorns from wild captures and wins.
short.gentleman.2: Get the Cherish Ball: it always catches.
short.ginkgo_merchant.1: Gain the Apricorns others pay in Ginkgo Trades.
short.ginkgo_merchant.2: Pay 1 Apricorn: a move's base power is 4/5/6.
short.guitarist.1: Get the Amp die: status symbols charge it.
short.guitarist.2: Electric attacks may double the Amp die once.
short.hex_maniac.1: Roll the status die to pick the status inflicted
short.hex_maniac.2: Stack new statuses; Ghost moves +1 power.
short.hiker.2: Rock and Ground types: +4 Health, −1 Initiative
short.interviewers.1: When others get a stamp, battle them to win it.
short.interviewers.2: Swap taught moves between your Pokémon.
short.kindler.1: Remove an Apricorn Tree for 3 Firewood.
short.kindler.2: Fire attacks: 1 Firewood burns and deals +2.
short.lady.1: Gain 7 JP; Evolve Costs are 2 less.
short.lady.2: Once per battle, fully heal a party Pokémon.
short.ninja_boy.1: Initiative Advantage always lets you go first.
short.ninja_boy.2: Using Initiative Advantage inflicts a status.
short.parasol_lady.1: Set the Weather; matching moves +2 power.
short.parasol_lady.2: Take 2 less damage from Weather-type moves.
short.pearl_acolyte.1: Follow Palkia; your token counts as 2 cards.
short.pearl_acolyte.2: Get Palkia; weaker for each missing Shard.
short.picnicker.1: 2 free Forest tiles; fly to Campsites.
short.picnicker.2: Crafting a stew gives another stew free.
short.platinum_acolyte.1: Follow Giratina; your token counts as 2 cards.
short.platinum_acolyte.2: Get Giratina; weaker for each missing Shard.
short.poke_fan.1: Weak Pokémon take at most 3 damage per attack.
short.poke_fan.2: Crafting a Battle Item gives another free.
short.poke_maniac.1: Attack with the foe's signature move.
short.poke_maniac.2: Get Substitute: its holder switches in to block
short.pokemon_breeder.1: Teach a Weak Pokémon its evolution's Egg Move.
short.pokemon_ranger.1: Store Pokémon in locked party slots.
short.pokemon_ranger.2: Moderate Pokémon grow with each opened slot.
short.psychic.1: Interact with things up to 2 tiles away.
short.psychic.2: Psychic/Ghost attacks: set 1 die to any face.
short.roller_skater.1: 2 free Plains tiles; wild Pokémon flee later.
short.roller_skater.2: Your Pokémon take at most 6 damage per attack.
short.ruin_maniac.2: Artifacts +1 power and can't be taken.
short.scientist.1: Search without battling; teach the moves found.
short.scuba_diver.1: On Ocean, draw a discarded Hidden Spot.
short.scuba_diver.2: After a Water attack, switch out and cure all.
short.sky_trainer.1: Glide down 2+ levels, then 4 tiles free.
short.sky_trainer.2: Flying types +1 power vs non-Flying foes.
short.swimmer.1: 2 free Ocean tiles; Water types +1 Initiative.
short.swimmer.2: Water attacks may count as Bug or Flying.
short.team_aqua.1: End on Ocean: jump to any Ocean tile.
short.team_aqua.2: Water moves +1 power; Water types take 1 less.
short.team_magma.1: End on a Mountain: jump to any Mountain tile.
short.team_magma.2: Fire moves +1 power; Fire types take 1 less.
short.team_rocket.2: Fainting deals 2; blast off to any tile.
short.tourist.1: Get the Landmark Tour sheet for Legendary Snaps
short.tourist.2: Teach Legendary Snaps; full tour gives 30 JP.
short.triathlete.2: Attack as any of your 3 move types.
short.undivided_acolyte.1: Follow Arceus: counts as all three Gods.
short.undivided_acolyte.2: Foes left with 2 Health or less faint.
short.veteran.1: Apricorn Stash: +2 Apricorns and +1 tile move.
short.veteran.2: Ice/Dragon attacks may add 2 status symbols.
short.worker.1: Pay 2 JP to build Roads where you walk.
short.worker.2: Steel switch-in: foe +3 fatigue, can't escape.
short.youngster.1: Weak Pokémon get +1 Health and +1 Initiative.
short.youngster.2: Draw 5 trainer cards and swap to one.
